why_use_this: Reach for this package when you need to numerically solve one of the three classical PDE types on a regular grid -- Laplace/Poisson (steady-state heat/potential, elliptic), the heat/diffusion equation (parabolic, time-marching), or the wave equation (hyperbolic, time-marching) -- and a closed-form solution either doesn't exist or isn't what you need (a discretized grid of values is). This is finite differences on a grid, not a general-purpose ODE integrator ([vani-calculus](https://github.com/enthusiasticgeek/vani-calculus)'s solvers step a single scalar state; PDE time-marching advances a whole grid per step, a different shape of problem entirely -- see the README's "Design decisions" for why this package deliberately doesn't depend on vani-calculus despite the surface similarity). Boundary conditions are Dirichlet-only for the elliptic solvers (fixed value at the border); the heat solvers additionally offer Neumann (fixed flux) and periodic (wraparound) variants. Before calling any `_step`/`_solve` function on the parabolic or hyperbolic side, check the matching stability number (`pde_heat1d_stability_r`, `pde_wave1d_courant`, etc.) yourself -- these explicit schemes are only conditionally stable and this package computes the number for you but does not enforce it.

math_notes.pde_laplace1d_assemble: Assembles the 1D Poisson/Laplace finite-difference stencil \( \dfrac{u_{i-1} - 2u_i + u_{i+1}}{\Delta x^2} \) (the standard 3-point second-derivative approximation) into a dense \( n \times n \) matrix, with boundary rows replaced by identity rows so Dirichlet values pass through `pde_laplace1d_solve`'s `mat_solve` call unchanged.
math_notes.pde_laplace1d_solve: Solves the 1D Poisson equation \( u''(x) = f(x) \) (Laplace's equation is the special case \( f \equiv 0 \)) with Dirichlet boundaries \( u(0) = \text{left\_bc} \), \( u(L) = \text{right\_bc} \), by assembling the discretized stencil into a dense matrix (`pde_laplace1d_assemble`) and solving the resulting linear system directly via `mat_solve` -- not iteratively.
math_notes.pde_laplace2d_assemble: Assembles the 2D 5-point Laplacian stencil \( \dfrac{u_{i-1,j} - 2u_{i,j} + u_{i+1,j}}{\Delta x^2} + \dfrac{u_{i,j-1} - 2u_{i,j} + u_{i,j+1}}{\Delta y^2} \) into a dense \( (n_x n_y) \times (n_x n_y) \) matrix, boundary rows replaced by identity rows -- the 2D analog of `pde_laplace1d_assemble`, exact for quadratic \( u \) (this package's own correctness tests exploit that: the 5-point Laplacian reproduces \( x^2 - y^2 \) to floating-point precision).
math_notes.pde_laplace2d_solve: Solves \( \nabla^2 u = f \) on a 2D grid with Dirichlet boundary values given by `boundary`'s border entries, by assembling the 5-point stencil (`pde_laplace2d_assemble`) into a dense matrix and solving directly via `mat_solve`.
math_notes.pde_heat1d_stability_r: The FTCS (Forward-Time Central-Space) stability number \( r = \alpha \, \Delta t / \Delta x^2 \) for the 1D heat equation -- the explicit scheme `pde_heat1d_step`/`pde_heat1d_solve` use is only stable when \( r \le 0.5 \); this function computes \( r \) but does not enforce the bound.
math_notes.pde_heat1d_step: One explicit FTCS time step of the 1D heat equation \( \partial u/\partial t = \alpha \, \partial^2 u/\partial x^2 \): \( u_i^{n+1} = u_i^n + r \left( u_{i-1}^n - 2u_i^n + u_{i+1}^n \right) \) where \( r = \alpha \Delta t/\Delta x^2 \) (see `pde_heat1d_stability_r`), with the Dirichlet boundary values re-imposed at \( i=0 \) and \( i=n-1 \) after the update.
math_notes.pde_heat1d_step_neumann: Same FTCS update as `pde_heat1d_step`, but with zero-flux (insulated) boundaries instead of fixed Dirichlet values -- the boundary points use a reflected/ghost-point stencil (\( u_{-1} \equiv u_1 \) at the left edge, and symmetrically at the right) so the derivative at the boundary is zero, rather than the value.
math_notes.pde_heat1d_step_periodic: Same FTCS update as `pde_heat1d_step`, but with periodic (wraparound) boundaries: the left edge's stencil reaches around to \( u_{n-1} \) and the right edge's reaches around to \( u_0 \), e.g. \( u_0^{n+1} = u_0^n + r(u_{n-1}^n - 2u_0^n + u_1^n) \) -- the grid behaves as a ring, not a segment with endpoints.
math_notes.pde_heat2d_stability_r: The 2D FTCS stability number \( r = \alpha \, \Delta t \left( 1/\Delta x^2 + 1/\Delta y^2 \right) \) -- `pde_heat2d_step`/`pde_heat2d_solve`'s explicit scheme is stable only when \( r \le 0.5 \), the 2D generalization of `pde_heat1d_stability_r`'s bound.
math_notes.pde_heat2d_step: One explicit FTCS time step of the 2D heat equation \( \partial u/\partial t = \alpha \nabla^2 u \), applying the same 5-point-Laplacian-times-\(\Delta t\) update `pde_heat1d_step` uses in 1D to every interior grid point, with Dirichlet boundary values from `boundary` re-imposed at the border after each step.
math_notes.pde_wave1d_courant: The Courant number \( C = c \, \Delta t / \Delta x \) for the 1D wave equation -- the explicit central-difference scheme `pde_wave1d_step` uses is stable only when \( C \le 1 \) (the CFL condition: information can't be allowed to propagate more than one grid cell per time step).
math_notes.pde_wave1d_first_step: The single special first time step the wave equation's 3-time-level central-difference scheme needs (no \( u^{n-1} \) exists yet at \( n=0 \)): derived from a Taylor expansion using the given initial velocity \( v_0 \), \( u_i^1 = u_i^0 + \Delta t \, v_{0,i} + \tfrac{1}{2} C^2 \left( u_{i-1}^0 - 2u_i^0 + u_{i+1}^0 \right) \) where \( C \) is the Courant number.
math_notes.pde_wave1d_step: The standard 3-time-level central-difference update for the 1D wave equation \( \partial^2 u/\partial t^2 = c^2 \, \partial^2 u/\partial x^2 \): \( u_i^{n+1} = 2u_i^n - u_i^{n-1} + C^2\left(u_{i-1}^n - 2u_i^n + u_{i+1}^n\right) \), where \( C = c\Delta t/\Delta x \) is the Courant number (see `pde_wave1d_courant`).
math_notes.pde_wave2d_courant: The 2D Courant number \( C = c\,\Delta t \sqrt{1/\Delta x^2 + 1/\Delta y^2} \) -- `pde_wave2d_step`'s scheme is stable only when \( C \le 1 \), the 2D CFL condition.
math_notes.pde_wave2d_step: The 2D analog of `pde_wave1d_step`: \( u_{i,j}^{n+1} = 2u_{i,j}^n - u_{i,j}^{n-1} + c^2\Delta t^2 \left( \dfrac{u_{i-1,j}^n - 2u_{i,j}^n + u_{i+1,j}^n}{\Delta x^2} + \dfrac{u_{i,j-1}^n - 2u_{i,j}^n + u_{i,j+1}^n}{\Delta y^2} \right) \), the 5-point-Laplacian version of the 1D central-difference update.
